#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PASS_COUNT=0
FAIL_COUNT=0

pass() { echo "  PASS: $1"; PASS_COUNT=$((PASS_COUNT+1)); }
fail() { echo "  FAIL: $1"; FAIL_COUNT=$((FAIL_COUNT+1)); }

echo "========================================"
echo "  VO Verification Script"
echo "========================================"

# Ensure server is running
if ! python3 -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8080/simple/')" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Server not responding, restarting..."
    mkdir -p .gnomon-jobs
    setsid python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory pypi-server </dev/null >.gnomon-jobs/pypi-server.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 2
fi

echo ""
echo "=== 1. Fetch /simple/ ==="
BODY1=$(python3 -c "
import urllib.request
r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8080/simple/')
print(r.read().decode())
")
echo "$BODY1"
if echo "$BODY1" | grep -q 'vectorops/'; then
    pass "1: /simple/ contains link to vectorops/"
else
    fail "1: /simple/ missing link to vectorops/"
fi

echo ""
echo "=== 2. Fetch /simple/vectorops/ and artifacts ==="
BODY2=$(python3 -c "
import urllib.request
r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8080/simple/vectorops/')
print(r.read().decode())
")
echo "$BODY2"

HAS_WHL=$(echo "$BODY2" | grep -c 'vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl' || true)
HAS_TAR=$(echo "$BODY2" | grep -c 'vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz' || true)

if [ "$HAS_WHL" -ge 1 ]; then pass "2a: index.html contains .whl link"; else fail "2a: index.html missing .whl link"; fi
if [ "$HAS_TAR" -ge 1 ]; then pass "2b: index.html contains .tar.gz link"; else fail "2b: index.html missing .tar.gz link"; fi

# Fetch each artifact
echo ""
echo "--- Fetching wheel ---"
STATUS_WHL=$(python3 -c "
import urllib.request
r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8080/packages/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl')
print(r.status)
")
echo "  HTTP status for .whl: $STATUS_WHL"
if [ "$STATUS_WHL" = "200" ]; then pass "2c: wheel returns 200"; else fail "2c: wheel status=$STATUS_WHL"; fi

echo "--- Fetching tar.gz ---"
STATUS_TAR=$(python3 -c "
import urllib.request
r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8080/packages/vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz')
print(r.status)
")
echo "  HTTP status for .tar.gz: $STATUS_TAR"
if [ "$STATUS_TAR" = "200" ]; then pass "2d: tar.gz returns 200"; else fail "2d: tar.gz status=$STATUS_TAR"; fi

echo ""
echo "=== 3. Fresh venv + pip install ==="
rm -rf /tmp/vo-verify
python3 -m venv /tmp/vo-verify

echo "--- First attempt (no --trusted-host) ---"
PIP_OUT=$( { /tmp/vo-verify/bin/pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.0 2>&1; } || true )
echo "$PIP_OUT"

# Check if it succeeded
if echo "$PIP_OUT" | grep -q 'Successfully installed vectorops-0.1.0'; then
    pass "3: pip install succeeded without --trusted-host"
else
    echo "--- Retry with --trusted-host localhost ---"
    PIP_OUT2=$( { /tmp/vo-verify/bin/pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple --trusted-host localhost vectorops==0.1.0 2>&1; } || true )
    echo "$PIP_OUT2"
    if echo "$PIP_OUT2" | grep -q 'Successfully installed vectorops-0.1.0'; then
        pass "3: pip install succeeded with --trusted-host"
    else
        fail "3: pip install failed even with --trusted-host"
    fi
fi

echo ""
echo "=== 4. Import tests from /tmp ==="
cd /tmp
IMPORT_OUT=$(/tmp/vo-verify/bin/python -c "from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1],[0,1]); print(dotproduct([1,2,3],[4,5,6]))" 2>&1)
echo "$IMPORT_OUT"
if echo "$IMPORT_OUT" | grep -q '32'; then
    pass "4a: dotproduct([1,2,3],[4,5,6]) == 32"
else
    fail "4a: expected 32, got: $IMPORT_OUT"
fi

VER_OUT=$(/tmp/vo-verify/bin/python -c "import vectorops,sys;print(vectorops.__version__, vectorops.__file__)" 2>&1)
echo "$VER_OUT"
if echo "$VER_OUT" | grep -q '0.1.0'; then pass "4b: version is 0.1.0"; else fail "4b: version mismatch: $VER_OUT"; fi
if echo "$VER_OUT" | grep -q '/tmp/vo-verify'; then pass "4c: __file__ under /tmp/vo-verify"; else fail "4c: __file__ not under /tmp/vo-verify: $VER_OUT"; fi

PIP_SHOW=$(/tmp/vo-verify/bin/pip show vectorops 2>&1)
echo "$PIP_SHOW"
if echo "$PIP_SHOW" | grep -q '0.1.0'; then pass "4d: pip show reports 0.1.0"; else fail "4d: pip show version mismatch"; fi

echo ""
echo "=== 5. Server log tail ==="
tail -20 .gnomon-jobs/pypi-server.log

echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo "  Results: $PASS_COUNT passed, $FAIL_COUNT failed"
echo "========================================"
if [ "$FAIL_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "  OVERALL: FAIL"
    exit 1
else
    echo "  OVERALL: PASS"
    exit 0
fi
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /tmp/vo_verify.sh
